propositions: Cloud description and comment Markdown must encode as structured ADF; DC description and comment Markdown must render as Jira wiki markup through asymmetric codecs.
Markdown↔ADF round-trip must reach idempotent fixed point for Cloud; DC must show zero monotonic length decay over repeated passes without content loss.

Echo-safety baseline stores canonical remote value after successful push; three-way baseline/local/remote comparison uses last-write-wins while flagging concurrent edits; origin gating preserves Jira-native constructs.
DC renderer converts safe structural units through pandoc with fallback identity path; unsafe units and ASCII tables pass through verbatim; timeout or missing pandoc returns data without loss.
Cutover lands codec capabilities before live state echo suppression; descriptions cut over before comments; both targets cut over together with echo-safety mechanism and conflict detection.

Committed corpus fixture must use stratified sampling under 500 KB per file with counts measured from fixture and asserted exactly; measurements from unreproducible 2026-08-03 export cannot be used as acceptance criteria.
